title: DegenMugen
tagline: DegenMugen is an NFT betting game based on an open source 2D fight engine ikemen go
description:
DegenMugen Features :
Own an NFT of a fighter, stage and earn rewards each time the game use it. You can also trade your NFT on a marketplace. Thousand characters and hundred fighters already exist
Create your character or stage then mint an NFT of it. You can sell your creation or use it in the game
Bet on the winner of a fight and earn rewards.
how_its_made: This project use web3js and react for the front end. For the smart contract dev i am using hardhat and solidity. And to interact with the game ikemen go i am using python. I planned to use Rarible but didn't have time at the end... My project will use Polygon at the launch. I impressed myself because its my first blockchain project (i had the last sentence because the "How its made" was not enought long ^^ ...)
